name: Refund fires before order cancellation when inventory fails
preconditions: order CREATED, payment CHARGED, inventory event consumed
expected_result: payment refunded BEFORE order cancelled (LIFO); notification never sent; saga state ROLLED_BACK
pass_fail_criteria: refund event timestamp < cancel event timestamp; no OrderConfirmed notification in topic

name: Redelivered PaymentFailed event triggers one refund, not two
failure_scenario: payment declines; Kafka redelivers PaymentFailed after consumer rebalance (at-least-once)
preconditions: idempotency key pay-77a4 stored on first processing
expected_result: exactly one refund row; dedup log records the second delivery

name: Timeout on shipping escalates to global saga compensation
failure_scenario: shipping.reserve exceeds the 30s per-step timeout (service down)
expected_result: all three compensations execute in reverse order; DLQ stays empty; trace shows compensation span tree
pass_fail_criteria: state machine reaches ROLLED_BACK within saga_timeout; no orphan reservations in inventory
